propagation.method: Deterministic scrambled Sobol integration of Gaussian scale inputs
propagation.distribution_assumptions: One common Gaussian certificate error and a correlated bivariate Gaussian scanner-transfer error, mutually independent.
propagation.covariance_combination: Full single-annotation covariance plus joint nonlinear scale-output covariance; annotation and scale groups assumed independent.
propagation.nonlinear_note: Maximum width retains physical station spacing 0.05 mm and tangent window 1 mm. Sampling changes make its local finite-difference Jacobian unstable; all components are propagated through the actual estimator.
propagation.joint_scale_note: Certificate-only and scanner-only max-width variances need not add to the joint nonlinear variance. The joint value is used in the combined budget.
propagation.convergence_note: Nested Sobol prefixes are convergence diagnostics, not independent replications or confidence limits on numerical integration error.

scope.uncertainty: Evaluated standard uncertainty, not a 95% interval or complete uncertainty budget.
unquantified: Local calibration-target coordinate errors beyond measured spans
Unmeasured temporal drift and paper dimensional change

scope.known_scale_correction: Retained references are not recentered. The small nominal correction is calculated separately and remains unapplied.
scope.annotation_order: No inference of independence or dependence is made from the order of repeated annotation values.
